title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31198v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. translated_title: ToolSmith：面向多模态搜索代理的自动工具生成框架
translated_abstract: 近期的多模态搜索代理通过编排一个小型的人工设计的搜索与视觉工具库，在多轮交互中结合推理、视觉和实时网络搜索，来回答超出参数化知识范围的问题。然而，这样的工具库创建和维护费时费力，并且在真实场景中遇到新的查询类型、证据格式和失败模式时会陷入僵化。相比之下，人类从业者在工具不足时，会从熟悉的部件中打造新工具并在不同任务之间复用。受此启发，我们提出了ToolSmith，一个自动工具生成框架，它能在精简的基础工具库之上生长并复用功能模块。我们在三个域内多模态搜索基准和十个域外基准上，采用VLM-as-a-Judge（视觉语言模型作为评判）协议对ToolSmith进行了评估。ToolSmith在多种规模的已部署代理上都持续超越基础工具库，且更大的骨干模型获得更大的性能提升，展示了
tldr: 该论文提出ToolSmith自动工具生成框架，通过在精简的基础工具库上自动生长并复用工具模块，在域内和域外基准上持续提升多模态搜索代理的性能，且模型规模越大收益越明显。
en_tdlr: ToolSmith is an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses tool modules on top of a lean base library, consistently improving multimodal search agents across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, with larger backbones reaping greater gains.
